reviews.name: Kingg
reviews.text: Hands down the best wings in Jersey — probably the whole USA. The staff is great, the drinks are cold. And if you like soup, try the she‑crab. Amazing.

reviews.name: Kenny Ketchum
reviews.text: We've been going to Charlie's for as long as I can remember, and it's one of the most consistent places you'll find. From the atmosphere to the staff to the ownership, it's one of those places that always feels right.

reviews.name: Shannon
reviews.text: The wings are top notch — I love the tailgun sauce. The Old Bay fries are a favourite, and the cheesesteaks are by far our favourite in the county. Their trivia nights are super fun as well.

reviews.name: Joshua Mankin
reviews.text: Best wings in NJ. Went for lunch and came back to get more wings for dinner. Now we can't wait to return. Service was incredible and everything was a great price.

reviews.name: Sean Simmons
reviews.text: I am addicted to the potato skins and the Southwest BBQ wings. Best sauce anywhere. The skins are loaded, not just on top. Our seventh visit this summer.

reviews.name: Avery Heaney
reviews.text: Best Philly cheesesteak I ever had — and South Jersey and Philadelphia are well known for cheesesteaks. Very good Yuengling on tap, and a very friendly staff.

reviews.name: Sozzer Ball
reviews.text: Outstanding wings. Try a side of the Top Gun sauce — deep pepper taste with oil for a lingering kick. Must have: the crab mac and cheese. Charlie's is a local institution, great vibe.

reviews.name: Christina McManis
reviews.text: This place never fails me. Not from the area and came back for a fourth time. Service was phenomenal, food was amazing. Prices are fair and worth the trip.

reviews.name: Mandy Holt
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. The food was delicious and reasonably priced and the staff were so engaging and friendly. They welcomed us and even gave us free baseball caps. It's a must visit.

reviews.name: Verified Viewz
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best spots in Somers Point. The atmosphere is always welcoming, the staff is incredibly friendly, and the food is consistently great. Whether you're grabbing a bite, enjoying a drink, or watching the big game, this is the place to be.

reviews.name: Sir Eats-a-lot
reviews.text: Came to Charlie's for their famous buffalo wings on a Sunday afternoon. We ordered the thirty buffalo wing and a combo wing with boneless tenders and fries. Ice cold draught beer, which is a must. Our server was great.
